references.text: God appoints craftsmen with wisdom to carry out the work on the sanctuary, the same theme of wise men performing holy work.
An appeal to all who are wise in heart to come and do everything the Lord has commanded, a direct parallel to the wise craftsmen.
God filled the craftsmen with wisdom to perform every kind of work, the same concept of wise men and holy labor.
The context describing Bezalel, Oholiab, and all the wise men whom God gave wisdom for sanctuary work.
The wise among the workers made the tabernacle, a continuation of the same theme of wise craftsmen in holy service.
Hiram was filled with wisdom and understanding to perform every kind of work in bronze, a parallel about a skilled craftsman in holy building work.
Men who were skilled in their work led the restoration of the temple, a similar theme about capable workers in holy service.
Paul describes himself as a wise master builder who laid the foundation, a New Testament parallel about wisdom in spiritual building work.
Different gifts but the same Spirit, each servant with their own gift—a parallel to how each craftsman came from their own work to serve.
The candidate describes the people themselves now beginning the work they had previously offered to do.
